original_target.title: Axisymmetry of equilibrium distributions for Onsager rods

full_original_statement:
For $`\kappa>0`$ and probability densities $`\rho\geq0`$ on $`\mathbb S^2`$ with respect to surface area, define

```math
\mathcal F_\kappa(\rho)=\int_{\mathbb S^2}\rho\log\rho\,dS+\frac\kappa2\iint_{\mathbb S^2\times\mathbb S^2}\sqrt{1-(p\cdot q)^2}\,\rho(p)\rho(q)\,dS_p\,dS_q,
```

with $`0\log0=0`$ and value $`+\infty`$ when the entropy is infinite. Is every global minimizer, for every $`\kappa>0`$, axisymmetric: does there exist $`e\in\mathbb S^2`$ such that $`\rho(Rp)=\rho(p)`$ almost everywhere for every rotation $`R`$ fixing $`e`$?
queries: "Onsager" "minimizer" "axisymmetry" (site:arxiv.org OR site:zenodo.org OR site:hal.science OR site:github.com)

sources.scope_comparison: The target quantifies over every global minimizer at every coupling for the square-root Onsager kernel on S2. The primary conclusion explicitly leaves local/global minimizer axisymmetry open for this kernel. Non-axisymmetric critical-point constructions or numerical landscapes do not prove such a point minimizes globally;Maier–Saupe polynomial kernels are different functionals. No later full matching proof,counterexample or complete announcement was located.
